name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A reliable way to turn any website into clean, usable text or data, so you don't have to build and maintain your own web-scraping machinery.
buyer: A founder building a niche monitoring or research product (prices, listings, news) who doesn't want to spend months fighting scraping infrastructure before they can sell anything.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce tools founder builds a competitor price-tracking product for local retailers and bike shops, using it to watch competitor sites without writing custom scrapers.
A real-estate data startup builds a 'new listings alert' product for a niche market by crawling dozens of regional listing sites through one API.
A local-news aggregator automatically pulls and summarizes small-town council and school-board websites into a weekly community newsletter.

money_ideas.idea: Subscription SaaS built on top (price monitoring, listings alerts, research digests) that resells the scraped/structured data as a finished product
One-off custom scraping/data project for a client who needs a specific dataset built once

steal_this: Pick one boring, underserved niche (e.g. local permit filings, niche job boards) and ship a $10/month email-alert product on top of it this weekend.
